As part of the design team, you'll also contribute to brand, web and marketing design, so we're looking for someone whose thinking doesn't stop at product. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for a designer who's equally comfortable working fast and working well. This is a maternity leave cover position for at least six months, with a possibility of staying on afterwards. How Youll Spend Your Time Own the end-to-end design of Bounce's product: the consumer app, consumer communications, internal tools and our partner platform, from a one-line idea to shipped UI Turn complex flows like payment plans, hardship options and credit reporting into clear, simple experiences for people going through financial stress Design workflows and features for partners, agents and operations teams Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Data and Compliance to ship realistic, buildable designs, and measure their impact through analytics and experiments Maintain and evolve our design system across all product surfaces Support Brand and Marketing with website pages, campaigns, presentations and brand collateral Manage multiple projects simultaneously and deliver polished work on tight timelines Requirements: 3+ years of work experience in product design Strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end product work across mobile and web Figma - proficiency required Experience with AI-assisted design and prototyping tools (Claude, Figma Weave, or similar) Strong visual craft, including typography, layout and interaction design Fluent in English (verbal and written) Ability to multi-task, organize, give and receive design feedback, and prioritize work B.Des or equivalent academic degree in Visual Communication This position is open to all candidates. Youll turn technical, data-rich workflows involving infrastructure, application programming interfaces (APIs), Terraform, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) into clear, effective experiences for security and DevOps professionals. Your work will help organizations manage access securely while shaping the next generation of products for people, systems, and AI agents. Expectations of this role This is a hybrid role. You will be expected to work from 1Password's Tel Aviv office 4 days per week. Requirements: Bring 5+ years of product design experience, including experience designing Business-to-Business (B2B) products. Use research, persona understanding, analytics, and user insights to guide design decisions for data-rich products. Bring strong Figma, design system, prototyping, and visual design skills, with the ability to quickly validate ideas through working prototypes. Work effectively with technical products and workflows involving infrastructure, Terraform, APIs, security, and DevOps. Collaborate openly, respond constructively to feedback, and make pragmatic design decisions that can be built and shipped. This position is open to all candidates.
